name: Cary A. Lubetsky
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Miami, Florida
about: Cary A. Lubetsky is an attorney who represents clients in the Miami, Florida area. Cary Lubetsky is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Cary Lubetsky chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Tulane University Law School and graduated in 1992. Cary Lubetsky passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1992.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Real Estate issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Cary Lubetsky has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
169 E Flagler St Suite 500 Miami, FL 33131
